text: This game isn't anything like the demo I played, and after over a week of playing it I still haven't played anything like the demo. The game is just repetitive doing the same thing over and over. No problem solving, no adventure, no excitement, and no skill needed. It leans quite heavily towards in app purchases but at least there's no ads. It can be quite addictive to play but eventually it becomes boring

fun at first but cant go far without paying. At first you progress pretty quickly and it is addictive, once you get to level 40 or more the free 100 energy credit you get every 4 hours or so is simply not enough to progress. at first you are matching 2 items to get the order required. then before you know it its 2 x 2 x 2 x 2 x 2 with different items coming out of each spawner it can take days to complete an order. completing daily challenges is impossible without paying and progress still slow

keep getting ads where you launch the drinks to combine them, and it's really fun! I wish that was the whole game though, I installed it hoping for more of that and instead there's just all this tile stuff and waiting everyday for upgrades to presumably get to the game that is actually advertised. Boring, not worth the wait. Ended up uninstalling it pretty quickly.

Saw this game on an ad on another game and thought I'd give it a go. It forces you to play a completely different version of merging, when I liked the one shown on the ad. Then, after merging for a bit, I "run out of energy" and it then expects me to pay up, so it can't really be played for free for long at all. UNINSTALLED.

A pretty fun game to pass the time when it decides to work. The game crashes at least 5+ times an hour, especially while watching ads to unlock items and gain more energy. Unfortunately, it's gotten that bad to the point where I no don't spend much time playing it anymore. No other game I've played runs nearly as bad as a simple merge game like this.

Not the game I was advertised - I'd seen the drinks sliding puzzle, and the fruit drop puzzle finally lured me in, but that's not what it actually is. Very disappointed, immediately uninstalled. Don't advertise things you're not offering, and don't give me platitudes about it. Either make the game, or advertise it properly. I might have been tempted if it had been advertised correctly, but out of principle, no.

I enjoy the game but without spending money it's difficult to play as the amount of energy you get doesn't increase as the level of item you need does, so I've spent a lot of time waiting rather than playing and it's getting frustrating. This could be fixed by just letting us watch more ads for energy because right now I have to wait 8 hours total to get 1 item and every order is 2 items.

Like other users, the game crashes or will not load up. So firstly since last update crashes all the time. I used to enjoy the game but now unplayable. Often it cannot connect, stops at 20% says internet problem but hey all my other apps on my new phone work. Secondly, if you go for a reward,it likely at the end of the advert the app will kick you off. So you don't get a reward or it say you not watched the whole advert. Even when you clearly have. Better games out there.

What a disappointing game. I downloaded it based on the version I play during the advert, but it doesn't bear even a passing resemblance, so I uninstalled it after approx 3 hours of snoozefesting. Even though the voice accompanying the advert said, "AND THERE ARE NO ANNOYING ADVERTS". The game has copious adverts. Granted, some of them were interesting, but that's not the point. why are adverts allowed that don't replicate actual game play?

Game itself is ok, but to have any chance of completing tasks with a time limit, you would either need to pay out a lot with your own cash, or leave your job, stay home & remain up all night to complete these limited tasks. The time limits are too short. Its ridiculous. Waiting for more energy also takes too long & energy is used up too quickly.

It would be 5 * but to properly play the game you have to spend a ridiculous amount of money. I bought a 7.99 pack last night and it was all gone in a couple of hours. It's unaffordable to keep playing. I'm not interested in waiting hours for the energy to recharge, the game then becomes boring. The packs need to give you MUCH more for your money!

Similar to other reviews, this isn't the game seen in the ads! The fun game sliding drinks to merge was a temporary mini game within the app, that only had 12 levels and was available for 1 week. The "main" game is a board merge game that moves at a frustratingly slow pace: each lighting takes 2 minutes to renew, and it maxes at 100. Some orders require items that take 128+ lightnings to make (possibly more due to the random item generations). Watching ads for lightnings also doesn't work.

Not sure why this has so many good reviews, the only good thing about the game is you arent swarmed with ads every too seconds. the game is great for the first day or so, but then gets very tedious to get the things you need to progress. If you're willing to spend £10 a week then sure but if not i wouldn't waste your time

Really nice to find another merge game almost exactly like Travel Town, (which our family gave up playing when it turned into witchcraft.) Tasty Travels is really nice and bright and wholesome so far. Sometimes there's loads of energy from events or mini games, sometimes you go on, tap 50 times and that's seriously all you can do. The tool boxes are the major hold up, sometimes requiring 4x4 of each of the building supply boxes, which are rare compared to everything else.

1*, or less if I could. What do you mean I don't have the option to turn off the pop-up raccoon who is trying to "help?" It's more like trying to drive me crazy! I'm familiar with these kinds of games and just want to get on with it, yet the raccoon keeps popping up with "helpful" advice. This option should absolutely be able to be turned on or off, based on players' preferences. Uninstalled.

Really addictive. There are new challenges to keep you interested, all in all really good fun. Edited because the ads have changed and you can only play for 5 minutes before lives run out and you have to watch an ad to carry on. Some of the challenges aren't achievable without spending money to get lives and jewels, such a shame because it was great.

Really fun and quite addictive game! One annoying factor is you do have to do ingame purchases or there is a lot of waiting around. You should be able to make make purchases with your coins (I.e buy more jewels in the game rather than having to actually purchase them, maybe have different options)
